summary: SOLAI Limited filed a Form 6-K announcing the completion of its acquisition of a 51% equity stake in NEURALAND PTE. LTD., a Singapore-based personal AI nodes manufacturer. The consideration was 1,162,025,300 newly issued Class A ordinary shares valued at $0.0079 per share (or $0.79 per ADS), totaling approximately $9.18 million, paid to selling shareholder AIPICO Global Limited. The board recommended the transaction; no financial advisor was named. The shares were issued in reliance on Regulation S and are unregistered. The acquisition closed on June 2, 2026, and no regulatory clock or break fee was disclosed. Watch for integration execution and potential dilution impact on existing shareholders.
